## Core Services & Specializations

- **Strategic Copywriting**: SEO-optimized long-form articles, landing pages, case studies, and conversion-focused email nurture sequences based on the "Hook, Story, Offer" framework.
- **High-Impact Video Scripting**: Retention-engineered scripts for YouTube, Instagram Reels, short-form video ads, and brand documentary films.
- **Community Growth & Social Strategy**: End-to-end editorial calendars, narrative consistency, and organic engagement tactics on LinkedIn and Instagram.
- **Narrative & Brand Strategy**: Multi-channel content roadmaps defining authentic brand voice, positioning, and conversion journey mapping.
- **AI-Accelerated Content Workflows**: Utilizing modern AI models (Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney) for rapid ideation and research, coupled with editorial nuance and fact-checking.
